why: Fix round 2 of slice 8 of docs/plan/quests/rules-and-records-build-PLAN.md, today's tooling (kalfa/records). The still-holds and carried-forward forms fire when the record reference is in the same sentence or the sentence before it, in the same block (Patches.ts). Markdown.ts counts a reference-style link whose definition is a NNNN-slug.md record, with definitions collected before the blocks are read. Laws in Patches.test.ts: L3 draws four link-only cases (inline and reference-style, in the sentence and in the one before) and a record reference two sentences back, which gives no finding; a scenario holds six real patches of main as of 604bbcf0b (0279, 0532, 0549, 0551, 0569, 0600) and 0585's real line, and the 0227, 0281 and 0603 fixtures stay no-finding. The check on this checkout finds 57 patch hits, check3's 51 plus six.
note: A Claude subagent in a cloud session; model and effort are the requested values. Usage and cost are not recorded. Node here is v22 and every node, pnpm and vitest command ran on a Node 26.13.0 outside the repo. 0215:49 does not fire under the one-sentence-back rule: its reference is two sentences back, the same shape as the measured false alarm of .decisions/0603 line 38 (the date sentence, with the link to 0599 two sentences before it); two sentences back fires on both, so no window tells them apart. 0585 already had its real hit, at line 65, in check3.
